**Limitations**

- Needs memory for 3 J + 1 subbands, each the size of the image, in 64-bit floats.
- The transform wraps around, so content near one edge can affect the other edge.
- The threshold rules assume independent coefficients. In the stationary transform, neighboring coefficients are correlated.

**Artifacts**

- Faint ringing along strong edges.
- With cycle spinning and few shifts, weaker versions of the blocky spots of the decimated transform.
